description: Read the devices where you are signed in to Last Price, most recently active first: device, browser, system, approximate location, masked address, how and when each signed in, and when it was last active. Your own account, not a workspace: needs a person's sign-in token (LASTPRICE_JWT from POST /api/auth/native-token); an API key or an agent's token is refused. Answers only while recorded sessions are switched on for your account (being rolled out).
name: list_account_sessions
